findings.title: Title screen menu lacks visual hierarchy
findings.where: Title screen, menu box below tagline
findings.problem: The 'New Driver' and 'Controls' options are visually identical: same font, color, size, and no hover/selection highlight. No clear primary action.
findings.why: Player doesn’t know what to click first; reduces conversion from idle viewer to active player. Feels like a prototype UI.
findings.fix: Make 'New Driver' bright cyan with a subtle glow or border; dim 'Controls' to 70% opacity. Add a pulsing white outline on hover.

findings.title: Radar is unreadable as an instrument
findings.where: Arena and Road screens, bottom-left panel
findings.problem: The radar is a black disc with faint green concentric rings and a tiny static triangle. No sweep animation, no contacts, no scale, no labels.
findings.why: Player can’t use it for spatial awareness or threat detection. Looks broken or decorative rather than functional. Undermines immersion in combat driving.
findings.fix: Add a rotating sweep line (green), label cardinal directions (N/E/S/W), show player position as a larger icon, and add blips for nearby entities when they exist.

findings.title: Vehicle health bars lack contrast and urgency
findings.where: Arena, Road, City — right-side CONDITION panel
findings.problem: All status bars (tyres, plant, driver) use the same green color even at critical levels. Body armor shows red 'x 0/3' but no bar or visual weight.
findings.why: Player cannot quickly assess damage state under pressure. Critical systems look no different from full ones. Reduces tactical decision-making speed.
findings.fix: Change tyre/driver/plant bars to yellow at 50%, red at 25%. Make Body Armor display a red bar filling left-to-right with '0/3' inside it, not beside it.

findings.title: Road screen lacks directional feedback
findings.problem: The route text says 'En route to Albany — 150mi remaining' but there’s no arrow, minimap, or compass to indicate direction or turn cues.
findings.why: Player must guess which way to go; increases cognitive load and frustration during navigation. Feels like driving blindfolded.
findings.fix: Add a small compass rose (N/S/E/W) next to the distance counter. Replace text with a dynamic arrow pointing toward destination relative to car orientation.

findings.title: Constructor weapon slots are ambiguous
findings.where: Constructor screen, left column under 'Weapon 1' through 'Weapon 10'
findings.problem: All weapon slots say '(empty)' in dim grey text with no visual affordance for selection or mounting. No icons, no drag targets, no highlight on hover.
findings.why: Player doesn’t know how to equip weapons or if they’re even interactive. Makes vehicle customization feel broken or unfinished.
findings.fix: Replace '(empty)' with a plus icon (+) that glows on hover. Add a small weapon category icon (e.g., gun, missile, turret) when selected. Show a tooltip on hover: 'Press Enter to mount weapon'.
